packageRules.description: Third-party GitHub Actions updates wait three days after release, then Renovate automerges them. The hive also merges Renovate PRs once the required checks pass, because mergeraptor is a trusted bot.
First-party projectbluefin/** actions merge right away and open at any time.

build-iso.yml, build-iso-utah.yml and promote-release.yml are human-merge paths in the hive (they build, publish and promote the ISOs). Give their updates their own branches, so a pin-only update to them is a PR of its own that the hive's pin-only exception can merge, instead of being held with other workflows. Renovate doesn't merge these updates itself, because its own merge would skip the hive's hold on these files. The hive merges a pin-only update, and anything else, a major included, waits for a person.

Don't digest-pin the Dakota base image in live/Containerfile. Its FROM lines are ghcr.io/${REGISTRY}/${TARGET}:${TAG}${BASE_DIGEST}, and build-iso.yml passes the cosign-verified digest as BASE_DIGEST, so a digest inside TAG gives a reference with two digests and the ISO build fails (#330).
Renovate never automerges GitHub Actions majors. The hive's trusted-bot merge policy is independent of this setting.
